name: deepinfra/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B
description: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B is an open-weights, 70-billion parameter language model developed by DeepSeek. It distills the advanced mathematical, coding, and logical reasoning patterns of the flagship DeepSeek-R1 model into the highly optimized Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct architecture.
